narr: Developing showers and thunderstorms along an approaching warm front arrived in southwest Virginia on the evening of July 10th. One storm in particular strengthened to strong levels over Buchanan County and inflicted downed trees due to gusty winds. A brief heavy downpour also resulted in flash flooding in front of a local grocery store near the town of Big Rock.
ev: High water impacted both lanes of US 460 in front of Rameys Grocery Store in the Big Rock Community.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING AFFECTING BOTH LANES OF US 460 IN FRONT OF RAMEYS GROCERY IN THE BIG ROCK COMMUNITY.
